## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 installer | `nswpedia-search-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows portable (no install) | `nswpedia-search-{{VERSION}}-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| macOS 15+ Apple Silicon (M1 and later) | `nswpedia-search-{{VERSION}}-macos-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS 15+ Intel | `nswpedia-search-{{VERSION}}-macos-x64.dmg` |

These builds are **not** code-signed by a paid certificate (Windows) or
notarized by Apple (macOS; the app is ad-hoc signed). Expect a one-time
warning on first launch:

- **Windows:** SmartScreen shows *Windows protected your PC*. Click
  **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Installs per user, no administrator
  rights needed.
- **macOS:** open the DMG and drag the app to Applications. The first launch
  shows *"NSWpedia Search" Not Opened*; click **Done**, then open
  **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, click **Open Anyway** next to the
  NSWpedia Search message and confirm with your password.

Upgrading keeps your settings, download folder and saved Real-Debrid token.
Full instructions are in the README's *Install* section.
